Yet, heaven ordained her rebirth before the apocalyptic world.
In her past life, she harbored fear towards his possessive imprisonment.
In this life, she depended on him, was infatuated with him, clung to him, loved him.
Together, they faced ghostly trickeries and walked through the hell on earth, never to be separated again.
reincarnated-as-a-wonderkid:
At Griffin Park Stadium, under England’s cold rain, Danein Blake a worn-out striker fighting for a single moment of glory meets a bitter end.
A dirty tackle, a whistle that never came, and a crash into the muddy pitch… that was his final chapter, or so it seemed.
But fate had other plans.
When Danein opens his eyes, he finds himself in the body of a ten-year-old boy named Leon Fischer, training at a prestigious football academy.
His memories remain, his passion still burns—but his name have been wiped clean.
And this time, he’s not alone.
The Player Insight System has activated.
Suddenly, numbers begin to float above the heads of players—
Potential: 92, Current: 34
Potential: 60, Current: 90
revealing their hidden abilities and future greatness.
For Danein, it’s not just a second chance… it’s a chance to see the game from a perspective no one else has.
From backstreet matches to elite academy trials, Danein—now Leon—must battle expectations, memories.
Can a man who once fell at the final whistle rise again from the kickoff?
“Can this time… I become the player no one forgets?”
replacing-sister-to-marry-into-a-wealthy:
After Bai Yin’s mother passed away, her father quickly brought his mistress and illegitimate daughter to the family home, while young Bai Yin was sent to live with her grandmother in the countryside.
Years later, the family brought Bai Yin back home. Everyone assumed that she, having grown up in the countryside, would be unsophisticated and unable to fit in with high society.
But no one expected the stunning woman who stepped out of the car, wearing a light blue qipao embroidered with exquisite su embroidery peonies, with long hair cascading down her shoulders. Her delicate features were like misty landscapes, and upon closer inspection, her eyes and brows were breathtakingly beautiful.
She even outshone her half-sister, who had already gained some fame in the entertainment industry.
road-to-mastery-a-litrpg-apocalypse:
Explore the Universe through the hardest, truest weapon: the Fist.
Jack Rust was a disillusioned biologist with a PhD—almost. When an extraterrestrial AI calling itself the System invaded Earth and thrust it into a world of aliens and violence, the least Jack hoped for was magic. Unfortunately, the System decided to spawn a forest dungeon around him and a goblin in his face, which left him little choice.
Armed with nothing but his fists, Jack must grow strong enough to survive entire menageries of monsters. He needs to return to civilization and find out what the hell is going on. He might also get magic—or not. Surprising himself, Jack discovers that violence is fun.
In this battle-ridden new world, Jack finds the life he always dreamed about. He won’t just survive. He will thrive.
savage-ascension-starting-with-god-tier-:
Reborn into a fantasy world of magic and aura, Rowan is the second son of a ranch family living boringly in a backwater village, with no magic and no inheritance.
To avoid rotting away in the countryside, he becomes a mercenary instead. Better to die fighting than waste away.
After his first kill, the Black Dream awakens: a power that lets him plunder abilities from everything he defeats.
But it's more than that. When he fights alongside others, their techniques become his: a master archer's deadly precision, a hunter's supernatural tracking, an assassin's shadow-step…
Every ally becomes his arsenal.
Ascension awaits! From the lowly dirt to the throne of the gods.

the-fire-of-divinity:
The Obsidian Maw was endless and was always growing by consuming worlds. This was the first lesson that Alex, a reincarnated soul from Earth, learned when he found himself reborn in the Obsidian Maw.
The second lesson he learned was that without a powerful Tyrant, a race or a group of people could only be at the bottom of the food chain in the Obsidian Maw, fit to be food for others, and at best eeking out a living between the teeth of the mighty.
The third lesson he learned in the abyss was that there were four privileges in life, which were power, freedom, safety, and longevity. In no time, he learned that he could only use two out of the four privileges, and sacrifice the remaining two to afford the first two.
To pick power and freedom was to decide to become a Tyrant. To prioritize power and longevity was to become an Apostle. And lastly, to seek safety and longevity was to be employed as a Drone.
The decision of which of the four perks he wanted to use was non-negotiable. He had to pick two and sacrifice two, or someone would pick for him, which would automatically make him food for his betters.…
the-goddesss-personal-doctor: Migrant worker Yang Yu was betrayed by his girlfriend, leaving him with a massive debt. To repay it, he was forced to work at a high-end club, enduring all kinds of humiliation. However, by a twist of fate, he unlocked the “Yin Yang Nine Mysterious Scripture,” gaining extraordinary divine abilities. After transforming into a divine healer and bodyguard, Yang Yu embarks on a journey of revenge—determined to make a powerful female CEO fall for him!
the-heiress-carrying-his-heir:
The night before her coronation, Princess Elara of Dravara made a mistake she could not take back. Her friends begged her to enjoy one last night of freedom before duty tied her forever. So she escaped the palace in disguise. One night. One party. One stranger whose touch she could not forget. She left before sunrise, thinking no one would ever know.
But secrets always return. Weeks later, Elara finds out she is carrying the child of the man she cannot even name. And on her coronation day, as she prepares to wear the crown, fate plays a cruel trick, the same man comes back, not as a lover, but as an assassin sent to kill her.
He almost ended her life that day. His blade touched her throat. But instead of striking, he whispered that it would not be today. Then he disappeared into the dark, only to return again, this time hiding among the men who wished to become her bodyguards. Now he stays close to her, walking beside her every day, guarding her in public, while secretly waiting for the right moment to finish the job.
Elara now carries a dangerous secret: she is a queen with a crown on her head, a child growing in her womb, and an assassin always by her side.…
the-informal-tomb-raiding-diary-she-is-t:

the-outliers-evolution-to-the-worlds-str:
In a world where, unbeknownst to most of Earth's population, people with special powers exist, known as Meta-Humans. Such people belong to one of two opposing organizations.
The first, known as Harmony, aims to coexist with regular society and protect them from superhuman or supernatural threats while remaining in the shadows.
The second, known as Eden, aims to overthrow regular human society and establish a world where the super-powered reign supreme.
These two opposing sides have been fighting for centuries, with countless conflicts scattered throughout history.
The power balance between the two had remained even for a long time, and in order to tip the scales in their favor, Harmony began a certain project...the creation of nine orbs made using pure, natural power, known as Meta-Orbs.
These orbs can grant a person unimaginable power, but right as the creation of these objects is completed, a conflict results in all nine Meta-Orbs being scattered throughout the world...and anyone who comes across them will gain immense power, even normal humans, therefore giving rise to the world's first unnatural Meta-Humans.…
the-reborn-aristocrats-daughter:
Situ Xin was highly intelligent, but because she had been an orphan since a young age, she was quite unemotional.
During her last mission, she was betrayed by “one of her own.” As her soul was in the process of Soul Formation, she was saved by the Phoenix Jade Pendant she wore, allowing her to be reborn as a fetus in her mother's womb. Moreover, she carried a space with her.
Let's see how she lives a different life after being reborn in 1988.
A new work by Ai Guo—Rebirth: Not To Be Cannon Fodder

Watch as Mi Zhiyao fiercely dumps her scumbag fiancé, deals with her greedy cousin, and then leads the once-declining Mi Family back to the pinnacle of their family.

the-transmigration-before-death:
He fell, but he did not die.
At least, not in the way he expected.
The world he hated spat him out into another, a place where the sky bleeds, where gods are fractured, and where names weigh heavier than lives.
Here, he is someone else.
Someone cursed.
Someone forgotten.
Yet in the ruins of memory and the echo of laughter that was never his, a strange truth coils:
that death is not an ending,
but a beginning far crueler.
A book without pages.
A family without love.
A body that doesn’t belong to him,
and a voice in the dark that whispers of eternity.

transmigrated-to-a-beastworld-as-the-laz:

My name is Chen Huai’an, and I have cancer. I’m dying. Lately, I’ve become obsessed with a virtual girlfriend game. I top up my account to buy her cultivation techniques and magical artifacts. Even though I’ve emptied my wallet, I laugh like a fool. I always thought it was just a game—until one day, my virtual girlfriend sent me a pill. The next moment, the pill appeared in my hand… Am I… not going to die?!
My name is Li Qingran. My cultivation has been crippled, my spiritual roots dug out, and I’ve been expelled from my sect. I cower in a dilapidated hut, waiting to die. I thought my life was over—until I met a mysterious senior who never shows himself. This senior heals my wounds and helps me cultivate. I grow stronger and stronger, eventually becoming the most powerful sword cultivator in the Cangyun Realm. I’ve heard that the spiritual energy in Cangyun is depleting, the Dao is dim, and an immortal from another world plans to merge their soon-to-revive realm with ours. An age of chaos and opportunity is upon us. Even immortals may face death in this struggle. I scour the world for traces of this senior. I want to protect him—and become his Dao companion!!!

what-the-wives-in-my-dreams-are-real:
Ye Yu transmigrated into a fantasy world and awakened the Dream Simulation System.
After each dream, he could randomly acquire a power from the dream.
Initially, Ye Yu planned to slowly grow stronger this way until he could dominate the entire world.
As time passed, Ye Yu experienced more and more dreams.
But he later discovered that the wives in his dreams actually existed in reality.
As the saying goes, having one girlfriend is dangerous, but having many girlfriends is life-threatening.
When these immensely powerful demonesses and empresses started showing up one by one, Ye Yu’s first reaction was to run away.
what-why-am-i-suddenly-an-undead-hottie:

Brought back to life as skeleton by the Goddess of Death, Ray is tasked with growing stronger to face the dangers of the world as a monster. But when he evolves into a more human form, he finds to his horror that not only is he a girl now, he's drop-dead gorgeous!
whispers-of-worlds-beyond-a-series:
[WSA 2025 Entry]
Aiden Chase has always lived in the shadow of his family’s legacy. As the eldest son of the renowned Chase family, celebrated for their relentless pursuit and capture of Magi- beings cursed with extraordinary powers- he was raised to uphold their name. But everything changes when Aiden awakens to a power of his own, a fire within that marks him as the very thing his family hunts. When his father hunts him down, Aiden is rescued and taken to Genvah Academy, an illustrious academy for Magi hidden in the outskirts of Soleil. At first, Aiden hopes the academy will offer him solace and a chance to reclaim a semblance of peace. But Genvah Academy nor Soleil is no haven.
Beneath the city's golden spires lies darkness- secrets, betrayal, and a looming war that threatens to consume everything. As Aiden unravels the truth about his powers and his family’s legacy, he must navigate a world far more dangerous than he ever imagined.
Peace is fleeting, and survival comes at a cost.

On the last day of high school, I got into a fight with a kid I used to bully.
It was a stupid, pointless scuffle, and in the middle of it, I tripped and hit my head on a rock.
That’s when the memories came flooding in - the memories of another life, of a different world.
Suddenly, everything made a twisted kind of sense. I realized two things.
First, I was in a game I used to play in my past life.
Second, I was a villain. A villain!
Not the cool and mysterious kind, either.
